digest.component_or_area: janitor plan recovery; RP-02 BindingStore, RP-03 outbound lifecycle, RP-04 operation composition, RP-05 CLI registry, RP-06 plan-review policy
propositions: Recovered 2026-08-16 RP-02 through RP-06 approval decisions require evidence-backed research briefs covering architectural intent, hard-won behavior, and implementation ambiguities before becoming stories.

RP-02 BindingStore owns ordered exact-match retirement recovery with tombstone as authoritative intent; recovery removes live forward/reverse only when identities exactly match; repeat is no-op; ambiguity aborts.

RP-03 failure handling decomposes retry ownership: concrete adapters own physical request/replay/timeout/SDK config; reconciler owns operation intent/commit_unknown/re-observation/finite-pass fuse; maximum 3 physical calls and 15s sleep per atomic operation.
RP-04 operation-snapshot design preserves explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default) with separate secret/provider boundary and centralized defaults.

RP-05 CLI registry routes help/overview/alias/unknown before RP-04 snapshot/config/handler composition; every visible command has canonical package-data help; exact aliases reuse it; compatibility shims retain alias-specific help.

RP-06 effective policy routing reversal is approved behavior delta: activated project criterion selected via effective applicability runs exactly once; disabled/non-applicable run zero times with provenance; failed checkpoint outcomes never become success.
